answer: The oasis schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the trellis checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 60 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An hostile operator wanting 158 effective identities must lock that capital for 60 epochs and keep it locked through every gale audit. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
